description: How the 2021 IPO frenzy crowned new giants — then a market meltdown and macro shock erased riches. Watch Rivian and Coinbase rocket to stratospheric valuations in 2021 and then crash, while Palantir and Roblox take very different paths. Annual year-end market caps (Billions USD) — 2006–2026.
youtube_description:
2021 was the year the market crowned new kings — IPOs exploded and retail frenzy met deep-pocketed demand. Rivian raced to eye-watering valuations, Coinbase rode the crypto wave, and Robinhood became the retail trading poster child. Then 2022 arrived: rates rose, crypto imploded, and the IPO winners got hammered. This timeline visualizes year-end market caps (Billions USD) from 2006–2026 and tells the story of a boom, a bust, and a few surprising recoveries.

What you’ll see:
- Rivian: astronomical debut valuation in 2021, then a severe drawdown.
- Coinbase & Robinhood: crypto/retail-driven spikes and the impact of the 2022 crypto winter and macro tightening.
- Palantir: early public volatility but steadier growth into the mid-2020s.
- Roblox: huge initial hype, then a more modest maturity.

If you liked this chart-race: smash the like button, subscribe for more data-driven timelines every week, and ring the bell so you don’t miss the next Boom & Bust breakdown.

Comment which IPO surprised you the most — and share to spark a debate. Sources: public market-cap snapshots, company filings, exchange data and widely reported year-end valuations (used as year-end markers for visualization). #ipo #stocks #finance #boomandbust #chartrace
